topic: stop a water stain from bleeding through fresh paint
core_question: How do I keep an old water stain from showing through new paint? (secondary: How do I get a red wine stain out of carpet?)
answer_summary: Clean the stained area and apply a stain-blocking (shellac- or oil-based) primer over it to seal the discoloration before applying the topcoat paint.; after the topic shift: Blot up excess wine immediately without rubbing, apply a solution of dish soap and hydrogen peroxide (or club soda), let sit, and blot repeatedly until it lifts, rinsing with cold water.
persona: impatient and curt; texting quickly with typos here and there
